'''2006 World Championship Day 3 consolation Noah Franke DS This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Noah Franke]] at [[2006 World Championship]] (Day 3 consolation); the list below is as posted on DeckTech by noah "thehooky" franke (2006-10-25).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35755 Deck Wreckers Turn 1 Deal W'06]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20071209040313/http://decktech.net:80/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35755 Internet Archive]</ref>
